question.text:
In an experiment on photoelectric effect, a student plots stopping potential $\mathrm{V}_0$ against reciprocal of the wavelength $\lambda$ of the incident light for two different metals $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$. These are shown in the figure.
Looking at the graphs, you can most appropriately say that:

options.text: Work function of metal $\mathrm{B}$ is greater than that of metal $\mathrm{A}$
For light of certain wavelength falling on both metal, maximum kinetic energy of electrons emitted from A will be greater than those emitted from $\mathrm{B}$.
Work function of metal $\mathrm{A}$ is greater than that of metal $\mathrm{B}$
